sourcePrompt: SWISH Modular Production Readiness Master Directive

stages.name: Full architectural audit
stages.goal: Establish an evidence-based map of current architecture, shared services, niche modules, security boundaries and release blockers.

tasks.title: Map app entry points, routes and build identities
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-01; PR #85 merge 00aa203 with 25/25 route-registry checks; PR #90 niche-routing workflow run 810 completed successfully on tested head; main snapshot 8d84f319cb778c84cf1ba1152c8a2b56c2680dd0. Verified registry, entry/home/dedicated route ownership and configured build identity source contract. Installed-device launch remains outside this verification.

tasks.title: Map shared services, hooks, backend functions and database dependencies
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-02 maps app/components/contexts/hooks/services/constants, canonical registry, Expo build preparation, Supabase-compatible backend, Edge Function inventory, SQL migration count, workflows and current direct-query/runtime verification gaps. Per-function authorization and deployed call-path matrix remains outstanding. Static 2026-11-02 source matrix added at docs/SWISH_EDGE_FUNCTION_SECURITY_MATRIX.md: inventories all 25 deployable Edge Function directories and records source-observed JWT, tenant, paid-niche, owner/admin, public-read and internal-secret gates. This does not verify deployed function parity, live RLS/grants, internal-secret callers, direct-query authorization or runtime call paths; S1-02 remains IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED.

tasks.title: Audit every registered niche for real functionality and isolation
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-03; all ten registered entry routes and specialist/capture configuration inspected. Static findings: Cards/Fossils/Beauty/Tech use shared /capture fallback; Cards/Fossils/Beauty/Tech use generic overview (Cards has one dedicated grading route); no full scanner-to-sale, niche data-isolation, web or device acceptance evidence yet. PR #94 merged 9c18466: canonical/legacy specialist IDs resolve to owning niche; all 25 checks passed. PR #95 merged e4c1a8c: Threads Flip Department/Style/Outer Shell Material specialist-specific mapping regression test; 25/25 checks passed. PR #96 merged 04fd59d: eBay publish mapping now prefers canonical department over legacy gender_category and explicitly maps outer_shell_material; 15/15 checks passed. These are source/CI proofs only; live eBay save/reopen/publish and device acceptance remain outstanding. PR #98 merged d168e99: ten-niche contract tests now verify every configured seller-evidenced specialist field maps to its canonical eBay item-specific name and inferred values are excluded; all 25/25 checks passed. PR #99 merged dd0ff10: swish-list-generate now safely defaults absent/null/malformed AI item_specifics to an empty object before specialist enrichment; all 15/15 checks passed. These establish source/CI robustness only; live Edge Function deployment and category-aspect save/reopen/publish acceptance remain outstanding.

tasks.title: Record security, entitlement, eBay, finance, sync and release blockers
tasks.evidence: docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md#s1-04; docs/SWISH_ENGINEERING_AUDIT.md; docs/SWISH_ENGINEERING_HANDOVER.md. Security, entitlement, eBay finance/messages/sync, category specifics, order allocation, Play Store, device and deployment blockers consolidated. Remediation and live acceptance remain open in downstream stages.

tasks.title: Reconcile open PRs, branches and current main before implementation
tasks.evidence: GitHub API rechecked 2026-11-02 after PRs #97-#99: PR #97 merged 069308bf; PR #98 merged d168e99 (25/25 checks passed); PR #99 merged dd0ff10 (15/15 checks passed). Latest main is dd0ff10e3927465fb83f5269d1f068376f4d31ae. Latest-main workflow set currently has 15 checks running (ten branded Android JS bundles, Master Admin shell, regression/niche isolation, niche-routing, Edge Function syntax/secret-boundary and gated live integration); no completed failures at snapshot. Earlier OTA jobs on 069308bf were superseded/cancelled as subsequent main commits landed, so OTA publication for the latest main is not evidenced. No APK build was triggered. Recheck latest main workflows and compare against main before future merges.

stages.name: Implement foundation architecture and registry
stages.goal: Make existing architecture boundaries explicit and enforceable without creating duplicate registries or services.

tasks.title: Define shared core/module boundaries against existing code
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md (2026-11-02): shared core/module boundaries and dependency validator implemented; canonical niche registry extended with typed contracts and ten scanner routes; typed extension/scope/evidence contracts and dependency rules added; architecture and cross-niche regression tests authored. Tests in this report are explicitly NOT executed in the editor. Status IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED; full acceptance CI and runtime/device checks remain open.

stages.name: Foundation 1 — SWISH Core
stages.goal: Complete shared authentication, tenancy, storage, AI, capture, inventory, eBay, lifecycle, pricing, notifications and navigation foundations.

tasks.title: Verify shared auth, tenant and server-side entitlement enforcement
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: source and catalog evidence covers existing auth/session, tenant/RLS and paid-niche guards, but authenticated positive/negative deployed role checks and full direct-query authorization coverage are incomplete. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify shared storage, image capture and AI service contracts
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: existing storage, image capture and AI service contracts remain in place; no full authenticated media/AI end-to-end acceptance or deployed revision parity was run. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify shared inventory and lifecycle services
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: atomic inventory lifecycle command and acknowledgement-based helpers implemented for covered transitions; remaining direct screen/table status writes and legacy detail paths still need migration and acceptance. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify secure eBay OAuth, listing, orders, messages and sync flows
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: service-side eBay message ingestion and inbox acknowledgement fixes implemented; live OAuth/token refresh, listing, order, message pagination/body, provider send and sync acceptance remain open. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify pricing, fees, profit, notifications and settings foundations
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: fee aggregation and profit presentation hardening exists, but finance 400/499, complete multi-line fee allocation, settings/notification delivery and live reconciliation remain unverified. Keep IN PROGRESS.

stages.name: Foundation 2 — Standard resale workflow
stages.goal: Deliver one complete, repeatable scan-to-sale workflow for every supported niche.

tasks.title: Scan, identify, confidence and evidence
Condition, valuation and acquisition decision
Costs, margin, inventory and listing draft
eBay category, item specifics, edit, save and publish
Sales, fees, order reconciliation and profit

stages.name: Foundation 3 — Niche specialisation
stages.goal: Make each niche a distinct specialist configuration over shared foundations, with strict data and entitlement isolation.

tasks.title: Validate specialist IDs, prompts and capture requirements per niche
Validate niche attributes, condition and measurements
Validate valuation sources, category mappings and listing templates
Verify niche inventory, routes, permissions and branding isolation

stages.name: Foundations 4–6 — Optional specialist capabilities
stages.goal: Add advanced intelligence, specialist business tools and unique niche engines only where justified by the niche.

tasks.title: Select advanced intelligence capabilities by niche
Select specialist business tools by niche
Implement unique niche engines only where required
Test optional modules cannot contaminate unrelated niches

stages.name: Full production verification
stages.goal: Certify supported niches through automated, security, web, native, deployment and real-device evidence.

tasks.title: Run full type, lint, unit, integration and regression suites
tasks.evidence: PR #110 commit 64aae9d2b1cf6b99a547ff996a7d290461e5c81a: lint, TypeScript diagnostics, Edge Function transpile syntax, complete regression suite, Deno server authorization boundaries and Android bundle checks all passed. Automated checks are implemented and passing; live external integrations and real-device acceptance remain separate.

tasks.title: Verify tenant, niche, entitlement and credential security
tasks.evidence: PR #110 commit 64aae9d2b1cf6b99a547ff996a7d290461e5c81a: server-only secret-boundary guard, Deno authorization boundary tests and niche isolation regression tests passed. Deployed RLS/grants and live role/tenant/entitlement verification remain outstanding.

tasks.title: Verify web parity and production deployment
tasks.evidence: PR #110 commit 64aae9d2b1cf6b99a547ff996a7d290461e5c81a: production web export jobs passed for all ten niche variants. Actual hosted deployment, domain routing, authenticated web parity and production smoke tests remain outstanding.

tasks.title: Build and inspect release APKs only at release milestones
tasks.evidence: PR #110 commit 64aae9d2b1cf6b99a547ff996a7d290461e5c81a: Android JavaScript bundles and branded configurations passed for all ten niches and the private Master Admin launcher. A separate clothing APK build was triggered on main; remaining nine niche APKs and the signed owner APK have not yet been built and inspected.

tasks.title: Complete real-device, live integration and operational acceptance
Close all critical/high defects and publish evidence-backed release verdict
Meet Google Play release requirements for each published niche app
tasks.evidence: Google Play policy requires Android 16 (API 36) for new apps and app updates from 31 August 2026. PR #112 adds a shared Expo config plugin, generated Gradle property verification, SDK 36/Build Tools 36.0.0 installation and APK target-SDK assertions. It also adds EAS APK profiles for all ten niches, matching `*-play` Android App Bundle profiles, and a separate owner-only Master Admin APK profile. This remains BLOCKED until API 36 native builds and target manifests pass, persistent release signing is confirmed, signed AABs are generated for all published niche package IDs, and per-app Play Console declarations/policy review are completed. The owner-only Master Admin launcher remains a separate internal-distribution artifact. PR #112 also increments niche and Master Admin runtime versions for the native API 36 rebuild and restricts automatic OTA publication to JS/assets-only paths; native app config, plugins, dependencies and Gradle changes no longer trigger OTA publication without a rebuilt APK.

knownReleaseRisks: Paid niche access and trusted server-side entitlement enforcement require complete API/RLS coverage.
eBay finance recurring 400/499 and fee aggregation/sign conventions remain unresolved.
eBay messaging must not report success after a failed provider send.
eBay localized category aspect/item-specific normalization requires live verification.
Some inventory/detail paths need trusted niche authorization rather than tenant-only checks.
Marketplace reconciliation for listings missing external IDs needs verification.
Multi-line and multi-quantity order allocation, fee aggregation and interrupted-import recovery remain incomplete.
Real APK/device launches, signing, web parity, deployment and external CI billing constraints require evidence.

changeLog.change: Created initial evidence-based control register from the seven-stage master directive and existing repository handover.

Eight remaining open PR branches are stale/diverged and must not be merged without targeted review and fresh validation: #59 (21 ahead/107 behind), #56 (1/113), #52 (9/214), #51 (9/214), #49 (1/220), #41 (39/328), #40 (4/329), #33 (16/522). #59 is the highest-priority production-readiness repair, but its 12-file change set needs conflict-aware rebase/reimplementation and full CI before merge. #56 overlaps #59 on branded build config and is likely superseded; #52, #51, #41, #40 and #33 require dependency and current-main review before any integration. No stale branch was merged or force-pushed.

Production Control API refresh hardening merged as #67 (7ed2bad). eBay credential refresh compare-and-swap protections merged as #68 (bca027b). Server-side niche repricing authorization and guarded price application merged as #69 (0ef4dcc). Fresh PRs #70 (OTA/Android release safety) and #71 (Post-Order safe errors) are awaiting CI; no stale PR #33 or #59 branch was merged.

Merged PR #70 (b799685) for mandatory Android regression gates, safe OTA release-note handling and Master Admin APK identity verification; merged PR #71 (1ea2776) for safe eBay Post-Order errors; merged PR #72 (6e7c9d6) for durable niche/specialist/category attribution in the existing sales ledger. Closed stale PRs #33, #40, #56 and #59 as superseded after targeted reimplementation; no stale branch was merged or force-pushed. Remaining open legacy PRs #41, #49, #51 and #52 remain under review.

Merged PR #74 (3f6f1a0): eBay Hub now prefers durable sale-time niche attribution with a guarded legacy fallback and has labels/specialist fallbacks for all ten niches. Merged PR #75 (035439c): registered the owner-only Production Control route inside the isolated Master Admin APK route tree. Master Admin readiness, niche-routing and all ten web export checks passed; no APK was built. Remaining open legacy PRs are #41, #49 and #52; #51 was closed as superseded.

Closed PR #41 as superseded by the current isolated Master Admin shell and Production Control route (#75). Reusable manifest progress, photo-quality diagnostics and brand artwork changes already exist on main; its Islamic Numista regex fix is also already present. Remaining open legacy PRs are #49 and #52.

Merged PR #78 (63a832a): marketplace recommendations now require both a verified production implementation and a connected publish-capable connector; unsupported Etsy/Amazon automated capabilities are disabled. Merged PR #82 (ac6961c) with 25/25 checks: added normalized credential-free marketplace adapter contracts, operation-capability helpers, idempotency keys and architecture documentation without a schema migration or changes to eBay flows. Fixed a niche-isolation defect in niche-modules.json: Coins listed `coin-flipper` without `.tsx`, while the route preparation script filters exact file paths. No UI, database, auth, eBay, OTA or native release changes.

Merged PR #87 (ea7b35a): added a read-only production register validator and focused GitHub Actions evidence gate. The validator checks schema/status integrity, verified-task evidence, all ten canonical niche registrations and mandatory programme guardrails.

Merged PR #88 (719b7c3): Production Control now displays live ten-niche web export, artifact, regression, authorization and Android JS bundle evidence with explicit limits. Merged PR #89 (89ed4c3): added a selectable ten-niche certification matrix; all 140 niche-specific acceptance areas remain NOT VERIFIED until evidence is recorded. No app release, database, auth or eBay architecture changes.

Stage S1 audit pass: S1-01 VERIFIED against PR #85 route-registry checks and PR #90 niche-routing CI; S1-02 architecture map IMPLEMENTED in docs/SWISH_STAGE_ONE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md; S1-03 remains IN PROGRESS after static review of all ten niches, with shared scanner fallback and generic-home gaps recorded; S1-04 blocker map IMPLEMENTED; S1-05 VERIFIED against current main 8d84f31 and GitHub open-PR query (none open). Merged PR #97 (069308bf): refreshed production register and Stage S1 evidence. Merged PR #98 (d168e99) with 25/25 checks: added ten-niche canonical item-specific mapping and inferred-value exclusion contract tests. Merged PR #99 (dd0ff10) with 15/15 checks: hardened swish-list-generate against absent/null/malformed AI item_specifics before specialist enrichment. Latest main checks restarted after merges; earlier OTA publication runs on 069308bf were superseded/cancelled and latest-main OTA publication is not yet evidenced. Added a static source-level security matrix for all 25 deployable Edge Function directories and linked it to S1-02 evidence. Explicitly retained S1-02 as IMPLEMENTED pending deployed revision, RLS/grants, internal-secret caller, direct-query and live call-path verification.

Reconciled the seven-stage register with the existing S2/S3 implementation and acceptance report. S2 tasks are IMPLEMENTED (not VERIFIED) because tests were authored but not executed in the report; S3 tasks are IN PROGRESS with deployed auth/media/lifecycle/eBay/finance acceptance gaps retained. Google Play API 36 compliance remains BLOCKED pending native target verification, signed AABs for each published niche, release signing and Play Console declarations.

Added complete EAS APK profiles for all ten niches, matching Play AAB profiles, and a separate Master Admin APK profile. S7-07 remains BLOCKED pending native API 36 compilation/manifest verification, persistent signing, actual AAB artifacts and Play Console declarations.

PR #112 separates native API 36 runtime versions from prior installed builds and gates automatic OTA publishing to JavaScript/assets-only changes. Native app config, plugin, dependency and Gradle changes now require a rebuilt native artifact before OTA compatibility resumes. Play AAB/signing and Play Console acceptance remain open.
